messages.subject: just started using ggplot2
parts:
Somehow, I never used ggplot2 until today and quite enjoyed it.  Some very basic usage of qplot() and friends here:
http://anyall.org/blog/2009/05/zipfs-law-and-world-city-populations/

I'm impressed the simplest possible qplot() call often does what you want it to do.

Brendan
